offers_products.reason: Sells textbooks, digital learning platforms (Connect, ALEKS, Sharpen), and curricula; software and content are products.

offers_services.reason: Main offerings are content and digital platforms; teacher training is only a minor add-on.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Students buy Sharpen, Boards & Beyond subscriptions, rentals and course materials directly; students choose and use them.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells PreK-12 curricula to schools and districts, plus Inclusive Access and Sharpen Advantage to universities.

recurring_revenue.reason: Digital subscriptions, Evergreen delivery and annual course adoptions generate repeat purchases by schools and students each term.

cyclical_demand.reason: Education materials are required for courses; school and student spending is fairly stable in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Textbooks, subscriptions and study apps are small, frequent purchases per student, though district adoptions can be larger.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from content and software platforms, not staff time; training is minor.

large_customers.reason: Buyers are students, individual schools, districts and universities, a mix of households and many mid-sized institutions.

asset_heavy.reason: Publishing and digital software need content development and technology, not plants, fleets or property.

notes: Customer mix across consumers, schools and universities is judged from website text only; large_customers is a judgment call.
